summary: Maui Land & Pineapple Co. (MLP) filed an 8-K on 5/27/2026 to report a Purchase and Sale Agreement with DC Kapalua 1 Property, LLC for the sale of two land parcels in Kapalua, Maui: Lot 2-D (8.783 acres) for $10 million, and up to 3.5 acres of Additional Land at $1,138,565/acre. The buyer has 90 days for due diligence, after which it must deliver an acceptance notice and pursue governmental approvals; if approvals are not secured, either party may terminate. MLP receives a non-exclusive trademark license, a master lease for retail space, and amenities access for Kapalua Club members. Earnest money deposits become nonrefundable over time. Watch the due diligence outcome, approval timeline, and termination risk.
